title: The rules sheet
summary: The page's one paper moment: a page of the Orchestration Rules as your operator would hold it — five When → Then rules beside the checks that must pass before any rule fires and a small ink TRACE that plots whichever rule you choose.
story: Answers “will it be ours, or another agency running our outbound?” by showing the artifact: plain rules your team can read, edit and hire against. Three of the five cite the other layers' assets (the ICP, the Narrative OS), so the stack reads as one wired system, and the route drawing ties the sheet back to the header's band.

phone: ≤1023: the checks come first with the route beside them, then the five rules across the width. ≤767: the checks, then each rule as a compact card — When, then ‘Then …’ inline, then Channel · Owner on one mono line; the route figure and its hint leave on phones (the chosen rule's route would sit a screen away from the rule; each card's own words carry it). The cites to other assets are marked by weight only, never underlined.

reference.site: Height — automation rules (list of rules, the chosen one shown as When → Then)
reference.borrowed: A list of plain-language rules where choosing one shows what it does on a separate panel.
reference.kelwin: No product UI or cards: a 1px-ruled document on paper with its name bar and SpecimenTag; the detail panel becomes a small ink TRACE (the header's primitive) that plots the chosen rule's route; the one red is the chosen rule's index square.

motion: entrance (play once): the sheet lands, the key row appears, the five rules set one by one, the checks rise, and rule 2's route plots in ink on the small TRACE.
interaction: each rule is a button (aria-pressed). Hover or focus previews its route (it re-plots, 700ms); choosing keeps it and moves the red square to it. The rule text never hides.
on the live site: plays once on scroll. Reduced motion: final state, routes swap without drawing.
notes: ≈ 1,050px at 1440. The page's only paper section. One red: the chosen rule's square.
